definition_quote.value: "Journeyman plumber" means any person who customarily performs the work of installing plumbing and drainage under the employment and direction of a master plumber or, not being a master plumber, does plumbing repair work as a regular part-time occupation.
definition_quote.quote: "Journeyman plumber" means any person who customarily performs the work of installing plumbing and drainage under the employment and direction of a master plumber or, not being a master plumber, does plumbing repair work as a regular part-time occupation.

methods_authorized.quote: "Master plumber" means any individual qualified under this chapter engaging in or about to engage in the business of installing plumbing or plumbing systems.

license_tiers.quote: The board may issue a journeyman plumber or limited plumber license ... The board may issue a master plumber license ... The board may issue a trainee plumber license ... The board may issue a journeyman-in-training license

apprentice_supervision_requirement.value: A trainee plumber must work under the direct supervision of one or more licensed journeyman plumbers or licensed master plumbers. A journeyman-in-training must work under supervision of a licensed master plumber. A master or journeyman plumber may not have more than 3 trainee plumbers working under their direct supervision.
apprentice_supervision_requirement.quote: A master or journeyman plumber may not have more than 3 trainee plumbers working under the master or journeyman plumber's direct supervision.

apprentice_to_supervisor_ratio_regulated.quote: A master or journeyman plumber may not have more than 3 trainee plumbers working under the master or journeyman plumber's direct supervision.
